title: MPI 非阻塞集合：重疊進度與等待證據
titleEn: MPI nonblocking collectives: overlap and progress evidence
summary: 以合成資料重建「MPI 非阻塞集合：重疊進度與等待證據」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付三條時間軸、緩衝所有權表與有／無進度的反例。
summaryEn: Reconstruct MPI nonblocking collectives: overlap and progress evidence with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver three timelines, buffer-ownership tables and progress/no-progress counterexamples.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「啟動與完成契約」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Initiation and completion contract: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 若 wait 仍耗 8 ms，區分通訊尚未進展與其他 rank 遲到；以相同輸入保留起始與完成時間。
只在結果一致、活動緩衝未被修改且重疊有時間證據時接受最佳化。
MPI 非阻塞集合呼叫分開啟動與完成；可重疊的機會不等於自動獲得背景進度。
optionsEn: An 8 ms wait may mean no communication progress or a late peer; retain initiation and completion timestamps under identical inputs.
Accept optimization only with matching results, unchanged active buffers and timing evidence for overlap.
MPI nonblocking collectives separate initiation and completion; an overlap opportunity does not guarantee background progress.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。MPI 非阻塞集合呼叫分開啟動與完成；可重疊的機會不等於自動獲得背景進度。 與本階段判準一起判讀：輸入在完成前保持不變，輸出在完成後才讀取；集合順序在各 rank 一致。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. MPI nonblocking collectives separate initiation and completion; an overlap opportunity does not guarantee background progress. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Inputs stay unchanged until completion, outputs are read afterward, and collective order matches across ranks.

把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：輸入在完成前保持不變，輸出在完成後才讀取；集合順序在各 rank 一致。

quiz.question: 「啟動與完成契約」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Initiation and completion contract: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 名義式 max(12,8)+2 = 14 ms；變更式 max(5,8)+2 = 10 ms。只縮短獨立計算為 5 ms，通訊與序列成本不變。 全部負載、量測和門檻是原創教學假設，不是產品規格。
交付三條時間軸、緩衝所有權表與有／無進度的反例。
若 wait 仍耗 8 ms，區分通訊尚未進展與其他 rank 遲到；以相同輸入保留起始與完成時間。
optionsEn: Nominal: max(12,8)+2 = 14 ms; changed: max(5,8)+2 = 10 ms. Shorten independent compute to 5 ms; communication and serial costs remain unchanged. All workload measurements and thresholds are original teaching assumptions, not product specifications.
Deliver three timelines, buffer-ownership tables and progress/no-progress counterexamples.
An 8 ms wait may mean no communication progress or a late peer; retain initiation and completion timestamps under identical inputs.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若 wait 仍耗 8 ms，區分通訊尚未進展與其他 rank 遲到；以相同輸入保留起始與完成時間。 與本階段判準一起判讀：輸入在完成前保持不變，輸出在完成後才讀取；集合順序在各 rank 一致。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. An 8 ms wait may mean no communication progress or a late peer; retain initiation and completion timestamps under identical inputs. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Inputs stay unchanged until completion, outputs are read afterward, and collective order matches across ranks.

steps.title: 啟動與完成契約 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Initiation and completion contract · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「啟動與完成契約」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Initiation and completion contract and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若 wait 仍耗 8 ms，區分通訊尚未進展與其他 rank 遲到；以相同輸入保留起始與完成時間。
對照「啟動與完成契約」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。只在結果一致、活動緩衝未被修改且重疊有時間證據時接受最佳化。
本階段必須重驗：輸入在完成前保持不變，輸出在完成後才讀取；集合順序在各 rank 一致。
steps.instructionEn:
An 8 ms wait may mean no communication progress or a late peer; retain initiation and completion timestamps under identical inputs.
Against the nominal Initiation and completion contract result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Accept optimization only with matching results, unchanged active buffers and timing evidence for overlap.
Reverify this criterion: Inputs stay unchanged until completion, outputs are read afterward, and collective order matches across ranks.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若 wait 仍耗 8 ms，區分通訊尚未進展與其他 rank 遲到；以相同輸入保留起始與完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. An 8 ms wait may mean no communication progress or a late peer; retain initiation and completion timestamps under identical inputs.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 輸入在完成前保持不變，輸出在完成後才讀取；集合順序在各 rank 一致。
steps.checkEn: Inputs stay unchanged until completion, outputs are read afterward, and collective order matches across ranks.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Initiation and completion contract and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付三條時間軸、緩衝所有權表與有／無進度的反例。
在交接件中加入「啟動與完成契約」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：輸入在完成前保持不變，輸出在完成後才讀取；集合順序在各 rank 一致。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以合成資料重建「MPI 非阻塞集合：重疊進度與等待證據」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付三條時間軸、緩衝所有權表與有／無進度的反例。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver three timelines, buffer-ownership tables and progress/no-progress counterexamples.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Initiation and completion contract: Inputs stay unchanged until completion, outputs are read afterward, and collective order matches across ranks.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Reconstruct MPI nonblocking collectives: overlap and progress evidence with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver three timelines, buffer-ownership tables and progress/no-progress counterexamples. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。輸入在完成前保持不變，輸出在完成後才讀取；集合順序在各 rank 一致。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Inputs stay unchanged until completion, outputs are read afterward, and collective order matches across ranks.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
